scope: Emulator bench, scripting and write-watch update from octabam 5c71bc8c (23 Oct 2026): the non-blocking bench socket waits for the client instead of dropping the rest of a large reply (EAGAIN); the stall detector counts an address register that walks 4 KB or more as progress; plug, peek and call bench commands; --preload, --boot-load, --cmd-log-end, --foreign-writes with --stock-code (writes into a range from a PC outside stock code, Rtos::watchForeign), frame-stamped MIDI OUT and wait ... chg scenario lines; USB run-time settings read from the CS1 early block in the bench model. dsp_host gains -pword (a raw knob word with its LFO companion bits). The two DSP source gates (norep.py, nolabelprefix.py), the trap register (docs/TRAPS.md), the emulator README (docs/remixer/EMU.md), scripts/m68k-toolchain.sh with setup-linux and setup-mac. No builder file changed, so the native images and refusals of octabam-7b2984c8.json and the later extensions hold by file identity.

softwareTests.otEmuBuild: cmake -S sdk/octabam/tools/emu/ot_emu -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DOT_VENDOR=<octabam checkout>/vendor; cmake --build (Ubuntu GCC 15.2.0, WSL2, 23 Oct 2026): built; the same configuration built from the origin/main sources first.
softwareTests.ctest: ctest -E ^(rtos|dsp|repitch-stock|repitch-patch)$: 5 of 5 passed (emac, periph, mc68kColdFireTimingTest, mc68kHdi08ReceiveTest, mc68kColdFireDivideTest); the origin/main build passed its 3 (periph gained the plug/unplug and media-exhaustion cases).
softwareTests.dspHost: tools/harness/dsp_host/dsp_host.cpp compiles against the vendored dsp56300 headers (c++ -std=c++17 -c); not linked or rendered here.
softwareTests.gates: sdk/tests/test_dsp_source_gates.py (planted rep and label-prefix cases refused; every repository source free of label-prefix clashes; platform and base sources free of rep; the three modules listed before the gate date that carry a rep reported, not refused); modules:check refuses a planted rep in a platform source and passes the tree without it.
softwareTests.sdkTests: python3 -m unittest discover -s sdk/tests: see the pull request.

limitations: Software checks only: no stock image booted under the port, no module rendered, no hardware. The emulator core files are byte-identical to upstream and to the 7b2984c8 import.
